results.title: TypeScript: Documentation - TypeScript 4.9
highlights: The new satisfies operator lets us validate that the type of an expression matches some type, without changing the resulting type of that expression.
We could try to catch that bleu typo by using a type annotation on palette, but we'd lose the information about each property.
